The science interpretation's strongest objection is that SKN06 lacks a direct SKN01 authorization ingress despite originating all calls. That objection does not make the implementation unconstructible: SKL02's trigger is itself the exact post-ratification release precondition for the whole conformance loop, section 5 forbids implementation and execution before that release, and the runtime graph records typed information flow after activation rather than requiring authority metadata to be redundantly delivered to every orchestrating component. Calling SKN06 outside SKL02 would violate the contract whether or not a fourteenth edge existed. Direct comparator binding of oracle partitions deliberately avoids SKN01 forwarding and does not weaken the gate. The SKE05/SKE06 versus SKE09/SKE11 question is also non-material bookkeeping. SKE05/SKE06 are explicitly preserved candidate data dependencies carrying legal immutable enumerator products; SKE09/SKE11 are the sole addressed invocation/control stimuli. Section 3 and SK01-SK08 require exactly one addressed stimulus on the latter edges, so the dependency values are not a second invocation, expectation, comparator state, or leak. An implementation can prebind or reference those immutable dependencies and still trace exactly one call envelope. No blocking or material concern remains: the exact 96/48/6 construction, 1/4 and 1 values, pi inverse sentinel, tau, 5/8/16/17 costs, 36,864 cases, 73,728 deletions, 72 vectors, 25 exact negative calls, 2,102-byte golden, three requested atoms, eight forbidden atoms, terminality, and non-headline claims are coherent and preserved.
